[[Virbank City]] }} '''Choir Tournament''' (Japanese: '''VSシキジカ''' ''VS {{tt|Shikijika|Deerling}}''), titled '''VS Deerling''' in the [[Shogakukan Asia]] translation, is the 534th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 10th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}. It is subtitled '''Deerling''' (Japanese: '''コーラス・コンペティション''' ''Chorus Competition'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Choir Tournament''' in the Shogakukan Asia translation. ==Plot== {{incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * The [[Pokémon academy|Trainers' School]] performs in the [[Autumn Choir Tournament]]. * [[Roxie]] participates in the competition as a judge, having been requested to by {{adv|Blake}}. * Blake and {{adv|Whitley}}'s team wins the competition, awarding them to participate in another competition in [[Castelia City]]. * Roxie has [[Pop Roxie|her father]] take {{adv|Cheren}}'s class to Castelia City. * Blake reveals to {{adv|Looker}} that [[Bronius]] and [[Ryoku]] were spotted in the [[Castelia Sewers]], and their task is to go and investigate the area. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== * [[Pop Roxie]] ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Sawsbuck}} (Autumn Form) ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Black}} (fantasy) * {{adv|White}} (fantasy) * {{adv|Blake}} * {{adv|Whitley}} * {{adv|Cheren}} * {{adv|Bianca}} * {{adv|Looker}} * [[Hugh]] * [[Leo]] * {{adv|Yuki}} * {{adv|Maya}} * {{adv|Yuko}} * [[Hugh's sister]] * [[Pop Roxie]] * [[Bronius]] (fantasy) * [[Ryoku]] (fantasy) * [[Chairtarō]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Serperior}} ({{adv|Amanda}}; {{adv|White}}'s; fantasy) * {{p|Dewott}} ({{OP|Blake|Dewott}}) * {{p|Foongus}} ([[Foongy]]; {{adv|Whitley}}'s) * {{p|Croagunk}} ({{OP|Looker|Croagunk}}) * {{p|Lampent}} ({{adv|Bianca}}'s) * {{p|Whismur}} (multiple) * {{p|Clefairy}} (multiple) * {{p|Chatot}} (multiple) * {{p|Tympole}} (multiple) * {{p|Swablu}} (multiple) * {{p|Loudred}} (multiple) * {{p|Jigglypuff}} (multiple) * {{p|Sawsbuck}} (multiple; Autumn Form) ==Trivia== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=EBEBEB|bordercolor=CEB654 |fr=La compétition de chant choral |de=VS.
